name: Snowmobile
instructions: omr/instructions/8272-1-1.pdf (book 1: the snowmobile, functions on pages 2-3, steps 1-51); book 2 builds the alternate model

functions.does: The handlebars steer the two skis: the steering column turns the red steering arm at its foot, whose two steering links push the skis' spindles round.
functions.source: book: 1 steps 3-7 (front suspension and spindles), 19 (steering arm and links, column), 50 (skis, inset), 51 (handlebars)

functions.does: The left ski has independent suspension: it rides on two wishbones of thin grey beams, upper and lower, and moves up and down, the yellow shock absorber squeezing.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (blueprint and shock absorber, up-and-down arrows); steps 4-9 (wishbones and shock absorbers)

functions.does: The right ski has independent suspension, as the left.
The front shock absorbers' springs hold the front up and spring back.
functions.skip: springs only matter under gravity or force

functions.does: The track runs round its three black sprockets and the grey wheels beside them as the snowmobile is pushed along; nothing drives it.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (arrow along the track); track steps 1-10 (pages 36-40)

functions.does: Each ski rocks nose up and nose down on the pin that holds it under its spindle, following the ground.
functions.source: inferred: book 1 step 50 hangs each ski from its spindle on one axle; not sure it is meant to rock freely
